variants.headline: Home world answers colony's petition
variants.body: The home world has answered the colony's petition. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: A reply to the colonial petition
variants.body: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Petition receives an answer
variants.body: The colony has received an answer to its petition from the home world. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
